Post 1

New 50-day low set, then buyers stepped in. ASX 200 closed +0.28% at 8,696.50 — up 24.00pts but still down 2.41% over five days. Gold stocks led the recovery. The index is flat YTD. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔺 Energy +2.19%, Materials +1.28% drove the bounce. Consumer Staples the clear laggard at -1.15%. Defensives sold, cyclicals bought — a classic risk-on rotation inside a week that's still deeply in the red. #ASX #energy #materials

Post 3

⛏️ Gold names dominated the top five. PNR +9.30% to AUD2.82, ALK +4.92%, KCN +4.69%, BGL +4.29%. Four of the five best performers were gold stocks. When AUD gold sits at AUD6,132.68/oz, miners notice. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 4

🪙 AUD gold at 6,132.68/oz is doing the heavy lifting. Silver 91.60/oz, Platinum 2,521.58/oz, Palladium 1,865.40/oz. AUDUSD at 0.7135. A firm local currency hasn't stopped gold equities running hard. #gold #silver #commodities #ausbiz

Post 5

ASX bounced off a 50-day low but is still -2.41% this week. The line in the sand: can 8,696 hold if US markets wobble overnight? Watch AUD gold — does 6,132/oz sustain the miners? What's your call — base or breakdown? #ASX #ausbiz #trading
